hero.title: Where the Indian Ocean meets your private getaway

booking.title: Confirm your booking
booking.payHelp: Enter your M-Pesa number — you'll get an STK push to confirm.
booking.checkPhone: Check your phone and enter your M-Pesa PIN.
booking.successDesc: We've sent confirmation to your email. Felister will be in touch shortly.
booking.payHelpAfter: Choose how you'd like to pay.
booking.chooseMethod: How would you like to pay?
booking.methodStkTitle: Pay instantly with M-Pesa STK Push
booking.methodStkBody: We'll send a PIN prompt to your phone. Type your M-Pesa PIN and you're done.
booking.methodManualTitle: Pay manually via M-Pesa Pay Bill
booking.methodManualBody: Open M-Pesa yourself, pay to the paybill, then paste the M-Pesa code below.
booking.manualPaybillIntro: On your M-Pesa app: Lipa na M-Pesa → Pay Bill, then enter:
booking.step2: Choose Lipa na M-Pesa → Pay Bill
booking.step3: Enter the Pay Bill, account number and exact amount above
booking.step4: Enter your M-Pesa PIN and confirm
booking.step5: You'll get an SMS — copy the M-Pesa code (e.g. RKL12ABCD3) and paste below
booking.codeTooShort: M-Pesa code looks too short — paste the whole code from your SMS
booking.manualNote: Felister will verify your payment within a few hours and send confirmation by email.
booking.awaitingBody: We've recorded your M-Pesa code. Felister will verify your payment within a few hours and confirm by email.

footer.tagline: Coastal homes hosted with love by Felister

about.title: Hi, I'm Felister
about.subtitle: I host every guest like family
about.body: Born and raised on the Kenyan coast, I've turned my three favourite homes into a place for travellers to feel at home. I personally welcome each guest, take care of every detail, and know the best (and quietest) spots on the beach. Karibu sana — you're more than welcome.
